title: cyphocarpa quadrangula
intro: Cyphocarpa quadrangula, commonly known as 'Four-cornered Cyphocarpa', is a plant species belonging to the Amaranthaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cyphocarpa quadrangula are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, treat wounds, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant have been identified as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
